ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, on the left horizontal wire there is a node labeled +3V, and this node is connected downward to ground through a resistor R. A 12V voltage source is connected in series on the horizontal wire, with “−” marked on the left side of the voltage source and “+” marked on the right side. Point A is located at the right terminal of this 12V voltage source. Reasoning: The potential of the left node relative to ground is +3V. Since point A is at the positive terminal of the 12V voltage source, while the left +3V node is at the negative terminal of this voltage source, the potential increases by 12V from the left node to A. Therefore φ_A = 3V + 12V = 15V.
